methodology_other: Data were collected from the Buildings, Dwelling and Establishment Census and Households Listing from the Iraq Central Statistical Organization, the Post and Communication Activity for 2017, 2018, from the Iraq Ministry of Communications, the Demographic Survey Kurdistan Region of Iraq from the International Organization for Migration, Where are Iraq’s Poor: Mapping Poverty in Iraq from the World Bank, the Iraq Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey 2018 Survey Findings Report from United Nations Children's Fund, Environment in Numbers 2014 from the Iraq Central Statistical Organization (CSO), and the DTM Iraq Returnees Master List Round 108, 2019 from the International Organization for Migration. Census Bureau staff altered boundaries and modified the statistical data as detailed in the Metadata tab of the tabular data.
name: iraq-subnational-boundaries-and-tabular-data
notes:
The geodatabase contains boundaries for the national and first-, second-, and third-order administrative divisions, aligned to the Large Scale International Boundaries dataset from the U.S. Department of State. The feature classes are suitable for linking to the attribute data provided.

The tabular data contain total population for 2009 (census), 2013 (population estimates), and 2014 (population estimates), as well as information relating to households, information and communication technology, health, mortality, and people in need.
